operations.description:
Permanently deletes the specified review.
 The review must have been abandoned.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] delete review [PATH] rest service reviews [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Deletes the given comment.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] remove comment [PATH] rest service reviews comments [PARAMS] c id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Deletes the reply.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] remove reply [PATH] rest service reviews comments replies [PARAMS] c id r [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Removes the patch with the given id from the review. All of the revisions provided by the patch will be removed as well.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] remove patch [PATH] rest service reviews patch [PARAMS] id patch [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Removes the reviewer from the review.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] remove reviewer [PATH] rest service reviews reviewers [PARAMS] id username [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Removes an item from a review.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] remove review item [PATH] rest service reviews reviewitems [PARAMS] id ri [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Removes the revisions given from the review item in the review specified by the id. If the review item has no
 more revisions left, it is automatically deleted.
operations.T: [METHOD] delete [NAME] remove review item revisions [PATH] rest service reviews reviewitems revisions [PARAMS] id rev ri [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Get the user authentication token.
 
 This is a legacy version of the login request. Using GET is deprecated as your password is likely to appear in logs which record request URLs.
 Use the POST version instead.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] login [PATH] rest service auth login [PARAMS] name password user [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get the list of projects that the authenticated user is entitled to access.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] all projects [PATH] rest service projects [PARAMS] allowed exclude reviewers [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns a project description.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] project [PATH] rest service projects [PARAMS] allowed exclude key reviewers [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns a list of all repositories. This includes plugin provided repositories
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] all repositories [PATH] rest service repositories [PARAMS] available enabled limit name type [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Lists the contents of the specified directory.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] browse [PATH] rest service repositories browse [PARAMS] path repository [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents a particular changeset.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] change [PATH] rest service repositories change [PARAMS] repository revision [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents a sorted list of changesets, newest first.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] changes [PATH] rest service repositories changes [PARAMS] csid include max newest oldest path repository [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Returns the raw content of the specified file revision as a binary
 stream. No attempt is made to identify the content type and no mime
 type is provided.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] contents [PATH] rest service repositories content [PARAMS] path repository revision [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Represents the history of a versioned entity.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] history [PATH] rest service repositories history [PARAMS] path repository revision [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] get [NAME] repository details [PATH] rest service repositories [PARAMS] repository [SCHEMA]

operations.description: For backward compatibility we provide this method, but repositories should be referred to just by their key.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] svn repository details [PATH] rest service repositories svn [PARAMS] repository [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] get [NAME] details [PATH] rest service repositories [PARAMS] path repository revision [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] get [NAME] all reviews [PATH] rest service reviews [PARAMS] state [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Retrieves all reviews that are in one of the the specified states. For each review all details are included (review items + comments). The
 wiki rendered comments will be available via the <messageAsHtml> element
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] all detailed reviews [PATH] rest service reviews details [PARAMS] state [SCHEMA]

operations.description: To ignore a property, omit it from the query string.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] custom filter reviews [PATH] rest service reviews filter [PARAMS] all author complete creator date from moderator or project reviewer reviewers roles states title to [SCHEMA]

operations.description: To ignore a property, omit it from the query string.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] detailed custom filter reviews [PATH] rest service reviews filter details [PARAMS] all author complete creator date from moderator or project reviewer reviewers roles states title to [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get all the reviews which match the given filter, for the current user.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] filtered reviews for user [PATH] rest service reviews filter [PARAMS] filter [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Gets a list of all the reviews that match the specified filter criteria.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] detailed filtered reviews for user [PATH] rest service reviews filter details [PARAMS] filter [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get comment metrics metadata for the specified metrics version.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] metrics [PATH] rest service reviews metrics [PARAMS] version [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Return a list of Reviews which include a particular file.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] reviews for path [PATH] rest service reviews search [PARAMS] path repository [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Return a list of Reviews which include a particular file.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] reviews details for path [PATH] rest service reviews search details [PARAMS] path repository [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns Crucible version information.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] version info [PATH] rest service reviews version info [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Get a single review by its permId (e.g. "CR-45").
 If the review does not exist, a 404 is returned.
 
 The moderator element may not exist if the review does not have a Moderator.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] review [PATH] rest service reviews [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Get a list of the actions which the current user is allowed to perform
 on the review.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] available actions [PATH] rest service reviews actions [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Return all the comments visible to the requesting user for the review.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] all comments [PATH] rest service reviews comments [PARAMS] id render [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] get [NAME] general comments [PATH] rest service reviews comments general [PARAMS] id render [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] get [NAME] versioned comments [PATH] rest service reviews comments versioned [PARAMS] id render [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Gets the given comment.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] comment [PATH] rest service reviews comments [PARAMS] c id render [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Gets the replies to the given comment.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] replies [PATH] rest service reviews comments replies [PARAMS] c id render [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns the specified review.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] detailed review [PATH] rest service reviews details [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get a list of patches and their details for the given review
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] review patches [PATH] rest service reviews patch [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get a list of reviewers in the review given by the permaid id.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] reviewers [PATH] rest service reviews reviewers [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Gets a list of completed reviewers.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] completed reviewers [PATH] rest service reviews reviewers completed [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Gets a list of reviewers that have not completed the review.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] uncompleted reviewers [PATH] rest service reviews reviewers uncompleted [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns a list of all the items in a review.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] review items for review [PATH] rest service reviews reviewitems [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns detailed information for a specific review item.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] review item [PATH] rest service reviews reviewitems [PARAMS] id ri [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] get [NAME] review items comments [PATH] rest service reviews reviewitems comments [PARAMS] id render ri [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Get a list of the actions which the current user can perform on this
 review, given its current state and the user's permissions.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] available transitions [PATH] rest service reviews transitions [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Search for reviews where the name, description, state or permaId contain the specified term.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] reviews for term [PATH] rest service search reviews [PARAMS] max return term [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get a list of all reviews that have been linked to the specified JIRA issue key.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] reviews for issue key [PATH] rest service search reviews for issue [PARAMS] jira key max return [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get a list of all the users. You can also ask for a set of users.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] users [PATH] rest service users [PARAMS] username [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns the user details of the user mapped to a committer in a repository.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] mapped user [PATH] rest service users [PARAMS] repository username [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Returns the user's profile details.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] user profile [PATH] rest service users [PARAMS] username [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Get the user authentication token.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] login [PATH] rest service auth login [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] post [NAME] create review [PATH] rest service reviews [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
This method should no longer be used, as it uses a POST for a read-only
 retrieval operation and is provided for backward compatibility only.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] custom filter reviews [PATH] rest service reviews filter [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
This method should no longer be used, as it uses a POST for a read-only
 retrieval operation and is provided for backward compatibility only.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] detailed custom filter reviews [PATH] rest service reviews filter details [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] post [NAME] add changeset to review [PATH] rest service reviews add changeset [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]
[METHOD] post [NAME] add file [PATH] rest service reviews add file [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Old, non-restful name. Kept for backwards compatibility. Exactly the same as POSTing to /{id}/patch
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] add patch review 0 [PATH] rest service reviews add patch [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Closes the given review with the summary given.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] close review with comment [PATH] rest service reviews close [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Add a general comment to the review.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] add general comment [PATH] rest service reviews comments [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
For the effective user, mark all comments in a review as read (except
 those marked as leave unread).
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] mark all comments as read [PATH] rest service reviews comments mark all as read [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Updates the comment given by the perma id to the new comment posted.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update comment [PATH] rest service reviews comments [PARAMS] c id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Marks the comment as leave unread to the current user - it will not automatically be marked as read by crucible.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] mark comment as leave unread [PATH] rest service reviews comments mark as leave unread [PARAMS] c id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Mark the given comment as read for the user used to make this POST.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] mark comment as read [PATH] rest service reviews comments mark as read [PARAMS] c id [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Adds a reply to the given comment. This call includes the  repsonse header that
 contains the URL of the newly created entity.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] add reply [PATH] rest service reviews comments replies [PARAMS] c id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Updates a reply with the given newComment.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] update reply [PATH] rest service reviews comments replies [PARAMS] c id r [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Completes the review for the current user
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] complete review [PATH] rest service reviews complete [PARAMS] id ignore warnings [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Add the revisions in a patch to an existing review.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] add patch to review [PATH] rest service reviews patch [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Publishes all the draft comments of the current user.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] publish all comments [PATH] rest service reviews publish [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: publishes the given draft comment.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] publish comment [PATH] rest service reviews publish [PARAMS] c id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Immediately send a reminder to incomplete reviewers about the given review.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] remind incomplete reviewers [PATH] rest service reviews remind [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Adds the given list of reviewers to the review.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] add reviewers [PATH] rest service reviews reviewers [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Add the changes between two files in a fisheye repository to the review.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] add fisheye review item [PATH] rest service reviews reviewitems [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Adds the given review item to the review. This will always create a new review item, even if there is an existing
 one with the same data in the review (in which case the existing item will be replaced).
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] add review item [PATH] rest service reviews reviewitems details [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Adds a review item for each of the supplied crucibleRevisionData elements.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] add review items [PATH] rest service reviews reviewitems revisions [PARAMS] id [SCHEMA]

operations.description: This call includes the  repsonse header that contains the URL of the newly created entity.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] add versioned comment [PATH] rest service reviews reviewitems comments [PARAMS] id ri [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Adds the given list of revisions to the supplied review item, merging if required. For example, if the review
 item for  contains revisions 3 to 6, and if:
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] add review item revisions [PATH] rest service reviews reviewitems revisions [PARAMS] id rev ri [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Change the state of a review by performing an action on it.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] change state [PATH] rest service reviews transition [PARAMS] action id ignore warnings [SCHEMA]

operations.description: Uncompletes the review for the current user.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] uncomplete review [PATH] rest service reviews uncomplete [PARAMS] id ignore warnings [SCHEMA]

operations.description:
Sets the review item specified by itemId with the given reviewItem. The old review item is discarded. Can only
 perform this operation if the old review item specified by itemId can be deleted. The old review item's permId is
 not changed.
operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] set review item [PATH] rest service reviews reviewitems details [PARAMS] id ri [SCHEMA]
